description: This file defines the Perl package Git::SVN::Log, implementing SVN log-related functionality, including log retrieval, commit display, blame, and formatting utilities specific to SVN repositories integrated with Git.

methods.name: cmt_showable
methods.description: Determine if a commit is showable based on its revision and log description.

methods.name: log_use_color
methods.description: Decide whether to use colored output for logs based on configuration.

methods.name: git_svn_log_cmd
methods.description: Construct the SVN log command with appropriate options based on revision range and arguments.

methods.name: config_pager
methods.description: Configure the pager program for output display.

methods.name: run_pager
methods.description: Execute the configured pager program for output pagination.

methods.name: format_svn_date
methods.description: Format SVN commit date into a human-readable string with timezone information.

methods.name: parse_git_date
methods.description: Parse the Git date string, adjusting for timezone offset.

methods.name: set_local_timezone
methods.description: Set environment timezone based on global TZ variable.

methods.name: tz_to_s_offset
methods.description: Convert timezone string to seconds offset.

methods.name: get_author_info
methods.description: Extract and process author information for commits.

methods.name: process_commit
methods.description: Decide whether to show or defer commit display based on revision range.

methods.name: show_commit
methods.description: Display commit details, abbreviated if in one-line mode.

methods.name: show_commit_changed_paths
methods.description: Display the paths changed in a commit.

methods.name: show_commit_normal
methods.description: Display full commit information in a normal format.

methods.name: cmd_show_log
methods.description: Retrieve and display SVN logs, handle output formatting, filtering, and paging.

methods.name: cmd_blame
methods.description: Display blame information for a specific file path, optionally using a custom format.
